dct_creator_sm: Ilyas, Umbrin (Department of Plant Agriculture. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-0429-2174
dct_description_sm: The data were collected in mid-season (mid-August) and at harvest (early October) from field trials conducted at the Holland Marsh, Ontario, Canada. Carrot cultivars with varying susceptibility to cavity spot were seeded on muck soils from 2020 to 2022.
dct_title_s: Differences in incidence and DSI of cavity spot among carrot cultivars in field trials
